artifacts.notes: Complete 616-page Internet Archive delivery, 25,593,916 bytes. This is The Bobbio Missal: a Gallican Mass-book (MS. Paris. Lat. 13246), FACSIMILE, London 1917, Henry Bradshaw Society LIII: the first, image volume of the edition, not the separately printed edited text or notes-and-studies volumes. The existing enclosing edition groups the series; this artifact identifies its precise volume. Visual inspection bounded to artifact pages 5, 7, 11, 12, 100, 300, 600 and 616; title, series and facsimile character verified. No whole-manuscript folio audit or collation. Its OCR of handwriting is severely damaged and is not a Latin reading text. The scan preserves original-language manuscript evidence for later collation.
